authority: Selection, burden and policy rules are imported unchanged from the accepted derivation. Intervals come from the accepted numerical helper module. The governing design is the observed-assessment amendment, which authorises no clinical fact.

definitions.four_level_burden: All four declared levels are retained everywhere, including levels with no observed patient. No level is merged, dropped or intersected.
definitions.policies: P0 is the reference definition. P1 to P5 are complete named alternatives, each rebuilt over the full cohort with its own denominators. Differences combine measurement and population change and are not bounds of any kind.
definitions.record_availability: Documented availability among observed care, not a response fraction among administratively eligible patients.
definitions.selection_and_burden: Imported unchanged from the accepted derivation. No selection, day, burden or policy rule is redefined in this estimation script.
definitions.unknown_country: The unknown or other country level is retained in every accounting and in every stratum table. Nothing is recoded.

derivation_binding_verification.meaning: The estimation record may only be built on a derivation record that matches the current derivation code, tests, bound context and input verification.

estimand.target: The documented proportion of selected later pad-free status among patients whose selected early status documents pad use and who have a selected later status.

limitations: Descriptive estimation of documented care. No treatment effect and no causal quantity.
Intervals describe sampling uncertainty only. They do not cover measurement error, date uncertainty, documentary rule choice or follow-up selection.
A documented-burden contrast compares rule-defined documentary groups, not true clinical burdens.
Policy differences are not confidence bounds, identification bounds or a range of clinical truth.
A later pad-use record after early pad freedom does not establish relapse or any date of change.
No model is fitted here and no count gate licenses one.

gates.label: Three burden indicators, age and country.
Main structure plus early-day and year-day timing.

current_gate_diagnostics.meaning: Count adequacy and covariate structure only. No fit, probability, interval or test is produced.
current_gate_diagnostics.structural_support_scope: Preliminary structural support only: recomputed arm counts, complete outcome-by-burden cells, country support and covariate rank on each model's own eligible rows. Covariate overlap, functional form, separation, influence and leave-one-patient-out stability are assessed separately and afterwards, and a supported structure remains unfitted here.
current_gate_diagnostics.superseded_three_level_note: The current structure is the four-level documentary burden with five and seven slope degrees of freedom. The earlier three-level four and six slope screening is superseded for this target.

held_analyses: The original opportunity-conditioned primary target P(Y=1 | E=1, A=1, O=1) remains unestimated.
Missing-outcome pattern-mixture analyses and identification bounds remain held.
Imputation of the outcome and of early burden remains prohibited.
outstanding_before_any_fit: The gate diagnostics come from the current source-verified derivation and are preliminary structural support only, including actual-subset counts, cells, country support and rank.
A failed structural gate holds its candidate model. No burden level is dropped or merged to rescue it.
Final covariate overlap, functional shape and influence review is a separate outstanding step and is not satisfied by any count gate.

bootstrap_qualification.reporting_rule: Any failed draw makes the percentile interval conditional on successful draws and requires the deterministic score interval beside it. More than the declared invalid fraction holds the percentile interval for repair or an explicit method amendment. Successful-only resampling is never presented as complete.

Poland.meaning: A difference between two rule-defined documented-burden groups. It is not a difference between the corresponding unknown true clinical burdens, not an adjusted association and not a treatment effect.

country_specific_burden_contrasts.reporting: Every country level is reported, including the unknown or other level and any not-estimable stratum. These are descriptive stratum-specific contrasts. No interaction is tested and no stratum is selected by its result.

bootstrap_qualification.reporting_rule: A stratum without both declared groups is reported as not estimable. No resampling is attempted and no interval is implied.

unknown_or_other.meaning: A difference between two rule-defined documented-burden groups. It is not a difference between the corresponding unknown true clinical burdens, not an adjusted association and not a treatment effect.

observed_record_availability.covariate_description: Age and assessment timing are described in the separate covariate EDA record and are not restated or re-derived here.
observed_record_availability.meaning: The documented fraction of early pad users with a selected year status. It is not a response fraction among administratively eligible patients, not conditional on the unknown opportunity A, not a weight and not a missing-outcome bound. Structured blanks remain unknown and do not mean never assessed or untreated.

without_year_status_reasons.derivation: Recomputed from patient identity against the candidate year-window rows. Not inferred by subtracting published totals.

six_all_paired_transitions.meaning: Documented state at two selected assessments. It is not a clinical trajectory, not a relapse or recovery event and not evidence that pad freedom is permanent.
six_all_paired_transitions.row_denominator_definition: Patients in the given selected early-status row who also have a selected later status. Each early-status row has its own denominator.

six_pairs.denominator_definition: Early pad users under this policy who also have a selected later status. The numerator is a selected later pad-free status. Patients without a selected later status are described separately as record availability.
